about.title: About Us
about.description: At Fire Wave Sound, we focus on getting great performances and capturing them the right way. Whether you're tracking a full band, cutting vocals, or preparing a live set, we make the technical side seamless so you can stay locked into the music. We're musicians first. We know studio time costs money, energy, and momentum. That's why sessions here are efficient, collaborative, and pressure-free. You'll be involved in the decisions that shape your record, and we'll guide you when it matters. From recording and mixing to live sound production, our goal is simple: make your music hit the way it should — powerful, clear, and true to you.
